root_cause.text: In the cdns3 DRD gadget initialization error path, __cdns3_gadget_init() failed to disable DRD gadget mode when cdns3_gadget_start() returned an error, leaving Cadence USB3 hardware in gadget mode while cdns->role/state stayed INACTIVE and causing invalid role-switch behavior.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds cdns_drd_gadget_off(cdns); only in the cdns3_gadget_start() failure path, and the commit/CVE explicitly states that on gadget init failure “the DRD hardware is left in gadget mode while software state remains INACTIVE,” causing cdns_role_stop() to skip cleanup and leading to the host-side crash.

intent_record.intent_summary: Turn off the gadget DRD state when gadget startup fails so failed initialization does not leave the controller partially enabled.
intent_record.what: A call to cdns_drd_gadget_off(cdns) was added inside the error-handling branch after cdns3_gadget_start(cdns) fails, immediately after pm_runtime_put_sync(cdns->dev) and before returning ret.
intent_record.how: When gadget startup fails, the code now explicitly turns off the gadget/DRD side before returning, ensuring cleanup of partially initialized state and preventing the controller from being left enabled after a failed initialization.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly matches the root cause: it disables gadget DRD mode on gadget startup failure, preventing the hardware from remaining in gadget mode after __cdns3_gadget_init() errors.
